title: Dear Hadith Rejecters
normalized_text: have a question for you guys how do we know who rasulullah was is that based on a hadith or is it based on our gut feeling i feel that he did this i feel that he was like this i remember this one guy from college um he said to me why do you have a beard and i said well any what kind of question is that rasulullah had a beard and he said no he didn't and i said why do you assume that he didn't have a beard and he said because i saw the prophet peace be upon him in a dream and he didn't have a beard is our knowledge of who rasulullah was is based on dreams it's not based on dreams guys it's not based on what we want to believe it's based on who he was that's in regards to his physical description his words his actions everything that is everything that makes him who he is is built on what we know of him from what's been reported by eyewitnesses not by dreams not by our gut feeling and this is the issue with hadith rejecters they will find things about rasulullah that conflicts with their values think about think about it this way guys we all have different values we're all influenced by our environment we're influenced by our own experiences our own individual experiences and based upon that we have a different way we all as individuals view right and wrong differently morals and values differ based on our environments our experiences now with that in mind what is acceptable from the actions of the prophet peace be upon him to me will not be acceptable to you or vice versa but will be acceptable to you might not seem acceptable to me because of my experiences and my environment now it's influenced me however when i see something that i know came from rasulullah i take a step back i say to myself you know freddie it doesn't matter how you feel it doesn't matter what you think because you are influenced by the media you're influenced by the 21st century world you're influenced by your friends what you feel is right or wrong isn't necessarily so and you take your more you take your morals take them from rasulullah take them from what you find in the quran and the authentic sunnah and again that's the tragedy and that's the predicament that hadith rejecters find themselves in they've rejected hadith after hadith but now they're in a position in which to them is just a figment of their imagination it's the same with how christians today view jesus it's not the historical jesus but it's unfortunately whatever they want him to be now we have muslims doing the exact same thing to them is whoever they want him to be and does not reflect the reality of who he was imagine you revere a historical figure you follow the religion that he came with however you deny all the historical accounts that are attributed to him because some of that stuff conflicts with your morals and values that's so sad that's so pathetic that's all i have for you guys today salaam alaikum
